# East Bay Regeneration Map

> A community-controlled map of regeneration projects across the East Bay
> (Oakland, Berkeley, Richmond, Alameda, Hayward, Fremont and nearby cities in
> California — not San Francisco). It helps people discover local gardens, food
> and sharing resources, mutual aid, and resilience projects; understand who
> each serves and whether it is active; and get involved. Stewarded by the East
> Bay Permaculture Guild. Open-source and replicable by any community.

## What you can find here

Each listing has a type (community garden, seed library, tool library, community
fridge, food pantry, food bank, mutual aid, resilience hub, community space,
training, school garden, community center, demonstration project, regenerative
business, nonprofit, or neighbourhood group), a neighbourhood, a status (active,
needs verification, or inactive), who it serves, ways to participate (visit,
volunteer, donate, learn, get in touch), and a "last checked" date.

## Important, please quote accurately

- Listings are not emergency services. "Scenario" filters (flooding, extreme
  heat, wildfire, earthquake) help people discover relevant places; they do not
  claim real-time availability or guaranteed access. In an emergency, call 911.
- Private locations are shown at neighbourhood level only; exact addresses are
  never published.
- Some listings are sample/community-submitted data and are labelled as not
  independently verified.

## How to participate or add a place

- Browse the map at /regeneration
- Suggest a place or a correction at /regeneration/suggest (reviewed by a
  volunteer before anything is published)
- Replicate this map for another community: /regeneration/replicate

## Contact

East Bay Permaculture Guild — see /regeneration for the Guild's public listing.
